findings.title: Unpinned MCP Package Execution
findings.message: Server is launched with floating runner 'npx' without a pinned version for '@modelcontextprotocol/server-github'. Each start may fetch and execute a different, unverified release, exposing the client to typosquatting, package takeover, and supply-chain compromise. (npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github)
findings.remediation: Pin an exact package version (e.g. '@modelcontextprotocol/server-github@<version>') or run a locally audited path.

findings.title: Direct Shell Execution Wrapper
findings.message: Server launched via raw shell interpreter 'bash', increasing injection risk. (command: bash)
findings.remediation: Invoke server binary directly without shell interpreter.

findings.title: Known Vulnerability: mcp-remote exposed to OS command injection via untrusted MCP server connections
findings.message: mcp-remote is exposed to OS command injection when connecting to untrusted MCP servers due to crafted input from the authorization_endpoint response URL (Matched version 0.1.15 in advisory CVE-2025-6514)
findings.remediation: Upgrade to fixed version or apply sandbox.
